Program_Info.Program_Description_2000: WriteA is a native desktop app that puts vector illustration, page layout, and a real word processor on one canvas. Draw artwork, place it on the page, and pour in text that flows and paginates across pages — without juggling three apps or three subscriptions. Built for flyers, zines, reports, comics, manuals, posters, newsletters, and books. Free editor on Mac and Windows (saving included); a one-time purchase adds PDF, Word, EPUB, SVG, Markdown, and plain text export plus printing. Linux is free. No account, no cloud lock-in. Mac App Store id 980892066. Microsoft Store 9P18DGSDVQCR. Site: https://writea.com
